bio_en: Davit Tumanian, called Tsur ('crooked/wild') Davit, was a native of Aljavaz in the Van district, an illiterate villager deeply aware of his people's suffering. He joined the ARF before the great massacres, in the days of Peto and Vazgen, and after the slaughter of 800 Vaspurakan youths at Guzaldara in 1896 he refused the 'prudent' submission and went abroad. He later returned to the struggle in Van, was involved in the events around Vardges's arrest in 1903, was condemned to the gallows and saved by an amnesty. He was murdered in a vile conspiracy on Arark square in Van on 30 July 1910.
